official_observations: CANN official landing page divides the stack into accelerator libraries, graph engine, programming/compiler, runtime/driver and tools.
It links PyTorch, vllm-ascend and sglang community resources.
CANNLab is described as free online compute; Samples provides examples; Bench provides evaluation; governance includes TSC, PMC and SIG.

announcements.fact: Huawei announced comprehensive CANN open sourcing and ecosystem co-development.
Technical Steering Committee established; collaboration with Triton, PyTorch, vLLM and verl named. Planned release schedules are not treated as proof of completed releases.
